mainEntity.name: How long does a typical door installation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of a door installation varies based on the door type, existing frame condition, and any required modifications. A standard pre-hung interior door might take a few hours, while an exterior door with complex hardware or a custom frame adjustment could take a full day or more. Factors like the age of your property, especially in areas like Berkeley or Oakland, can influence the complexity due to differing construction standards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Installation time varies, from a few hours for standard interior doors to a full day or more for complex exterior or custom doors, depending on the specifics of the project and existing frame conditions.
